title: Ridgeline Installation Services Change Orders: Signing Window, Re-Quote Limit and Reductions
content:
A change to the scope of a signed Ridgeline Installation Services contract is made only by a change order the customer signs, requested as a change order request on the contract with the change order amount priced by the installer.

## Rules

1. **Open contracts only.** Change orders are accepted while the contract status is contracted, scheduled or in progress, as the contract record shows.
2. **Signing window.** The customer must sign the change order no later than the program's change order signing days, in calendar days, after the change order request was created. Days are counted as calendar days from the date part of the request's registration as day 0 to the signing date; an unsigned change order lapses after the last day and changes nothing.
3. **Increases.**
   > A signed increase posts as a change order billing line with the next change order number and incurs the program's change order administration fee — this clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for the change order administration fee.
4. **Reductions.** A signed reduction posts as a credit line of the type "change order reduction" and carries no fee.
5. **Re-quote limit.** The change order increase is the change orders billed less the change order reductions, as a percentage of the contract price. When that increase, counting the new change order, would exceed the program's re-quote limit percentage, the change cannot be made by change order and a new measure and quote are required.
6. **Signer.** Only the customer who holds the contract may sign a change order.

## Signing window check (hypothetical 5-day program)

| Request registered | Signed on | Day count | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 September 16:40 | 8 September | 5 | qualifies (last day) |
| 3 September 16:40 | 9 September | 6 | lapsed, changes nothing |
| 3 September 09:05 | 3 September | 0 | qualifies |

## Re-quote limit check (hypothetical contract price 5000.00, limit 10 percent)

| Already billed, net of reductions | New change order | Increase counting the new one | Made by change order |
|---|---|---|---|
| 300.00 | 200.00 increase | 10 percent | yes (does not exceed the limit) |
| 300.00 | 250.00 increase | 11 percent | no; a new measure and quote are required |
| 300.00 | 100.00 reduction | 4 percent | yes; posts as a reduction credit with no fee |

superseded_clauses: A signed increase posts as an install_change_order_billed row with the next change_order_number and incurs change_order_admin_fee_usd
